heroText: Every course focuses on disciplined physical training along with proper written guidance, so aspirants can prepare in the right direction with confidence and consistency.

police.title: Police Bharti Training
police.desc: Designed for Maharashtra Police Bharti aspirants who want disciplined physical preparation along with proper written guidance and recruitment awareness.
police.guidance1: Proper guidance about syllabus, exam stages, and preparation direction.
police.guidance2: Support in understanding important subjects like Marathi, maths, reasoning, and general knowledge.
police.guidance3: Guidance on planning self-study in a focused and practical way.
police.guidance4: Awareness about recruitment pattern, timeline, and required preparation.
police.ground1: 1600 m / 800 m running with timing improvement drills.
police.ground2: Shot put, sprint work, agility drills, and movement improvement.
police.ground3: Strength work including push-ups, pull-ups, core, and flexibility.
police.ground4: Regular physical assessment to track progress and readiness.
police.ideal: Ideal for: Maharashtra Police Bharti aspirants who need serious physical training with correct written guidance.

army.title: Army Bharti Training
army.desc: Focused batch for Army Bharti and Army Agniveer aspirants with disciplined physical routine, performance tracking, and written guidance support.
army.guidance1: Guidance for understanding Army Bharti stages, process, and preparation flow.
army.guidance2: Help in identifying key subjects and self-study direction as per requirement.
army.guidance3: Support in building discipline, routine, and goal-focused preparation habits.
army.guidance4: Basic guidance for rally process, documentation, and readiness.
army.ground1: Daily running sessions with timing focus and endurance development.
army.ground2: Pull-ups, push-ups, sit-ups, long jump, and high jump practice.
army.ground3: Stamina, recovery, and body-conditioning guidance from trainers.
army.ground4: Regular physical practice rounds based on actual field demands.
army.ideal: Ideal for: Army aspirants who want a disciplined training environment with proper physical development and written direction.

ssc.title: SSC GD / CAPF Physical Training
ssc.desc: Physical training batch for SSC GD, CAPF, and similar defence aspirants with PET/PST-focused preparation and written guidance support.
ssc.guidance1: Guidance about SSC GD / CAPF exam structure, stages, and preparation direction.
ssc.guidance2: Awareness of important written subjects and how to manage self-study effectively.
ssc.guidance3: Support for planning preparation with balance between written and physical stages.
ssc.guidance4: Basic guidance for documents, process, and exam readiness.
ssc.physical1: Ground training for PET / PST standards with disciplined routine.
ssc.physical2: Running, endurance, and body conditioning according to target requirements.
ssc.physical3: Guidance regarding height, chest, weight, and physical standards.
ssc.physical4: Practical support for building confidence before physical rounds.
ssc.ideal: Ideal for: SSC GD and CAPF aspirants who want strong physical preparation with the right written guidance.

physical.title: Only Physical Training Batch
physical.desc: For students who are managing written preparation on their own and want full focus on ground training, fitness, discipline, and performance improvement.
physical.guidance1: Guidance to align physical preparation with the target recruitment process.
physical.guidance2: Support in improving routine, consistency, and training discipline.
physical.guidance3: Monitoring and direction based on each student’s goal and physical level.
physical.routine1: Daily warm-up, stretching, and injury-prevention drills.
physical.routine2: Running programs tailored to target timing and performance.
physical.routine3: Strength, core workouts, sprint drills, and circuit training.
physical.routine4: Regular mock physical evaluation with progress feedback.
physical.ideal: Recommended for: Aspirants from any background who need focused physical training and expert ground monitoring.
